question_or_proposition: For the Section B.1(a) quarterly progress-reporting requirement, what event or condition satisfies 'until compliance is achieved as stated above' such that the obligation to submit progress reports in January, April, July, and October ceases?
required_context: Section B Schedule of Compliance item 1 (cyanide effluent limitations), including the stated 12-month deadline to achieve final effluent limitations and the immediately preceding compliance-schedule structure
notes: The nominated clause imposes a recurring reporting requirement whose temporal applicability hinges on an undefined terminal condition referenced to the cyanide compliance schedule above. Resolving when that obligation ends would change whether reporting was required during Federal FY2025 monitoring-obligation evaluation. The passage does not specify numeric limits (Purpose A) or classify missing effluent-monitoring results (Purpose C).
